[[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXgHrOzAVxuNTtbrK-w-ujudA2__VSWYcnz2yKnUSR4a4u_Qn6jQvi1kpmHrgYWwPiHxvCX1CGQtp6Zfz8ujsFDCB-SoAprEdhuxOZWfxPX68ebvehB0clJdwCQUHuSg), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESrwEB6zswFQncsZlYrWiA2xOtZz-lfM8DgIQGAmZ5GhRxh2Qji_QJvbbwziyeIPQkhz2_UgZqbCoiWP83OSr0Q2QLNt3CPbceC0-FQSIbsBcZ4d5wxMVz-IZnAdmARiYQP_occM09PoWz84rDTpYTagFdhzwX8AARBBGxf-RywgEgpOGVldNdTlFJndQaZPCm3ZOfx-rYF40yy5bn5Dc37EM8Fup_FP5NBlBmGNW7PFlM)]

d: THE LUDDITE LAB, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'The Luddite Lab (formally known as the Luddite Lab Resource Hub) is a project by the Distributed AI Research Institute (DAIR) designed to help unions, labor organizations, and workers resist AI and workplace automation.' Purpose, its reframing of AI job displacement as a management choice, its leadership (Alex Hanna), access, and a note that Luddite Labs, a commercial developer-tools company, is unrelated. Seven cards: DAIR's two pages, AI Weekly, LinkedIn, Buttondown, Luddite Labs, a video.
reading: The innocent reading first. The Overview identifies the hub, its maker and its aim, gives the argument of one of its primers, and separates it from a company with a near name.
findings: THE ENTITY HELD. 'The Luddite Lab Resource Hub provides resources for unions, labor organizations, and worker-organizers fighting AI and automation at work' is the record's quote, composed at its own grain; the case studies, primers and library are the hub's sections. Checked 2026-10-29 against the Labor Vector census record of the same day and the sources it saved.
THE HOMONYM KEPT APART. Luddite Labs, the developer-tools company (card 6), is named as unrelated; the record had no disambiguation for it.

THE LEADERSHIP RAISED. 'Founded and co-led by figures including sociologist and DAIR director Alex Hanna': the hub's About page, saved with the record, lists her on the team as 'Director of Research, DAIR Institute' and names no founder; the founding is the composition's, on the LinkedIn card of her launch post. The primer's reframing of displacement as 'a management choice' rests on the AI Weekly card; the record does not carry it.
THE LIBRARY'S OWN SELECTION UNSAID. The record's limit, that the library picks actionable organizing tools and 'typically shies away from general statements of principles', is not composed.
analysis: An organizing resource is composed as one, with its maker, its argument and its homonym. The composition gives a team member as its founder, from her launch post.
per_note: Alex Hanna (as founder, which the record does not state) and DAIR named; no identifier; DAIR's own pages cited.
